qualifier: SLCO organic anion uptake, sulfonation and steroids
name: Drug metabolism with SLCO anion uptake and sulfonation
rationale: All members concern drug/xenobiotic disposition (drug ADME, cytochrome and steroid metabolism, sulfonation); SLCO sodium-independent organic anion uptake and sulfonation distinguish it from the xenobiotic-export/bilirubin and broad CYP/FMO detoxification confusables.

qualifier: thyroid hormone plus GH, prolactin and leptin receptors
name: Growth control by thyroid hormone and GH, prolactin, leptin
rationale: Members cover organism growth/lifespan regulated by thyroid hormone (transport, receptor, generation, LAT-type amino acid transport) and GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signalling, unlike the IGF, IL-6-family cytokine and glucagon/somatostatin confusables.

name: Pain detection and nociceptive sensitization
rationale: All members concern nociception: detection of mechanical and thermal noxious stimuli, enhanced pain perception and excitability, and pain behaviour, versus confusables about K2P/K+ channel hyperpolarization and resting potential.

name: Organelle lumen pH regulation and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosome, endosome, Golgi and synaptic vesicle lumens with ANO6-type calcium-activated phospholipid scrambling, the latter absent from all pH/proton-exchange confusables.

name: Naive, memory and plasma B cell gene signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive/memory and plasma cell immunoglobulin expression signatures plus plasma cell and germinal centre differentiation, lacking the ICOS/Tfh help and B cell activation/proliferation pathways of the confusables.

qualifier: Tfh/ICOS help and B cell homeostasis
name: Germinal centre Tfh help and B cell homeostasis
rationale: Members cover germinal centre formation, ICOS co-stimulation and Tfh differentiation, memory, and restraint of B cell proliferation and apoptosis (B cell homeostasis), distinguishing it from B-signature and B cell activation confusables.

name: Heme and transferrin-bound iron uptake
rationale: All members concern iron delivery via heme scavenging/transport or transferrin endocytosis (with DMT1 defect), unlike confusables about free iron, cadmium, copper or manganese ion transport.

name: Tooth and ectodermal appendage development, EDA-NF-kB signalling
rationale: Members cover ectodermal derivatives (tooth odontogenesis, dentin, cementum, eruption, hair placode) and EDA receptor/NF-kB defects of ectodermal dysplasia, distinguishing it from skin/keratinocyte and enamel-mineralization confusables.

name: PDGF receptor-alpha and -beta signalling regulation
rationale: Nearly all members are positive/negative regulation of or response to PDGF receptor signalling, which the fibroblast-stroma and Hippo/YAP confusables lack.

qualifier: IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 with CBL attenuation
name: IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 signalling with CBL attenuation
rationale: Members concern IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3/G-CSF receptor signalling and its CBL/SRC-mediated attenuation, unlike STAT5/EPO/TPO/fusion-kinase and common-gamma cytokine confusables.

qualifier: blood group and selectin ligands, with protein sulfation
name: Fucosylated blood group and selectin-ligand glycan synthesis
rationale: Members cover GDP-fucose/fucose metabolism, ABO/Lewis antigens, nucleotide-sugar transporter CDGs and tyrosine sulfation supporting leukocyte tethering and HSC homing, distinguishing it from general N/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables.

name: Core circadian BMAL1:CLOCK-CRY:PER transcriptional feedback loop
rationale: All members describe the core clock loop of BMAL1/CLOCK activation and CRY:PER repression, unlike confusables on clock outputs (ROR/REV-ERB, PPARA metabolism) or neuronal MECP2/CREB.

name: Glutathione synthesis, turnover and transport
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis (GCLC, GSS), GGT-mediated catabolism, transmembrane and cystine transport, distinguishing it from redox/ferroptosis and gamma-glutamyl cycle defect confusables.

qualifier: arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial specification
name: Endothelial cell fate specification and vasculogenesis
rationale: Members concern endothelial fate commitment and differentiation (arterial, venous, lymphatic) and vessel formation/maturation, whereas confusables are heart, outflow tract and BMP-driven cardiac development.

name: Suppression of proinflammatory IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF production
rationale: All members are negative regulation of innate proinflammatory cytokines, distinguishing it from confusables regulating IL-10, IL-12, IL-2 and T cell responses.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis, complexes I/III and ATP synthase
name: Iron-sulfur cluster and respiratory complex I/III assembly
rationale: Members cover Fe-S cluster assembly, maturation of Fe-S TCA enzymes, inner-membrane insertion and assembly of complexes I, III and ATP synthase; Fe-S biogenesis and absence of complex IV, electron transport and mitotranslation distinguish it.

qualifier: eIF2alpha kinases HRI and GCN2, mitochondrial stress
name: Integrated stress response via eIF2alpha kinases HRI and GCN2
rationale: Members concern stress-induced translational control through eIF2alpha kinases (HRI, GCN2, PERK) including mitochondrial stress and UPRmt, unlike confusables centred on ATF6/IRE1 ER chaperone induction.

name: Blood pressure control by angiotensin and endothelin vasoconstriction
rationale: Members cover arterial pressure regulation via renin-angiotensin, endothelin and vasoconstriction, distinguishing it from natriuretic/cGMP, renal sodium and NO-smooth-muscle relaxation confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neurons
name: Cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron development
rationale: Members combine cerebellar granule layer, granule precursor and Bergmann glia development and motor learning with forebrain/thalamic and pyramidal neuron development, unlike the cortical-migration, commissure and retina confusables.

qualifier: hindbrain, spinal cord and cranial nerves
name: Hindbrain, spinal cord and cranial nerve neuronal development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem development, spinal cord patterning and motor/interneuron differentiation, and cranial nerve and ganglion development, distinguishing it from enteric, neural plate, midbrain dopaminergic and sympathetic confusables.

qualifier: HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation and hypoxic transcription
name: HIF-alpha oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation
rationale: All four members concern oxygen homeostasis via HIF-alpha hydroxylation and HIF-driven gene expression, absent from TCA, erythropoiesis and NRF2 confusables.

name: Transcriptional control of E-cadherin and cadherin-11 genes
rationale: All three members are positive/negative transcriptional regulation of CDH1 and CDH11, a topic none of the EMT, mesenchymal, RUNX3 or generic transcription confusables contain.

name: Sprouting angiogenesis regulation via VEGF production and responsiveness
rationale: Members are bidirectional regulators of sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation, migration and apoptosis and VEGF/FGF production and signalling, unlike Tie2, VEGFR ligand-binding, lymphangiogenesis and remodeling confusables.

name: Visual retinoid cycle in rods and cones
rationale: Members concern the rod and cone retinoid cycle, its vitamin A metabolism and its LRAT/RDH5/RDH12 defects, distinguishing it from general retinol metabolism, STRA6 uptake and A2E/ABCA4 confusables.

name: Wnt secretion, Wnt/Ca2+ signalling and blood-retina barrier
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand biogenesis/secretion, WNT5A-FZD non-canonical Ca2+ signalling and FZD4-dependent retinal vessel and blood-retina/brain barrier formation, unlike canonical Wnt, Hedgehog lipidation and PCP confusables.
